purpose: Manual post-model corrections for reviewed en-es learner-difficulty rows where the current automatic model visibly misorders early SRS vocabulary.

score_fields.min_score: Raise the effective learner-difficulty score to at least this value.
score_fields.score_override: Replace the effective learner-difficulty score exactly. Prefer min_score unless a reviewed row is too late or needs an exact placement.

correction_types.score_override: The row has a reviewed target and the model placed it too late or otherwise needs exact placement.
correction_types.score_floor: The row is valid vocabulary, but the model placed it too early.
correction_types.restricted_admission: The row is valid data, but should not be ordinary standalone SRS vocabulary.
correction_types.exclude_standalone_srs: Keep the row for audit/search/data completeness, but do not serve it as standalone new vocabulary.

policy.admission_override: Standalone SRS admission class. Topic stretching should not override restricted_admission or exclude_standalone_srs rows.
